rules.consensus: A call is shared by the set when every video that could be read has it, or all but one when at least three could be read.
rules.theme: A theme is agreed on when every video that takes a side on it takes the same one and at least two do; mostly, when one video dissents from at least three; split, otherwise.
rules.odd: A video stands apart when its lean is at least 0.5 from the median of the others, a quarter of the scale, and its own 95% interval does not include that median. Only videos with enough comments, or enough of the words read, take part.
rules.period: A change between two periods is called only when their ranges do not overlap. Otherwise it is within the spread.

verdict.text: Across 5 videos, the reviewers' words lean positive in 3, are balanced in 1 and lean negative in 1; the audiences lean positive in 1 and are balanced in 4. By theme, they agree on design and materials (praised), cushioning and comfort (praised), performance and innovation (praised), fit and orthotics (praised) and availability and hype (praised); they split on value and price and weight and durability.

consensus_words.text: Reviewers agree on Design and Materials (praised in 4 of 4), Cushioning and Comfort (praised in 4 of 4), Performance and Innovation (praised in 2 of 3), Fit and Orthotics (praised in 2 of 3) and Availability and Hype (praised in 2 of 2).

split_words.text: Reviewers split on Value and Price (praised in 2, criticised in 2) and Weight and Durability (praised in 2, criticised in 1).

brand_health_words.text: Across 240 comments on 5 videos, 109 read positive, 59 neutral and 72 negative.

agreement_words.text: Of 5 videos, the audience is measurably warmer than the reviewer in 1 and there is no clear difference in 4.

lineup_words.text: The Alphafly 4 is praised for its design and materials, while the Air Max 1000.3 is also praised for its design and materials. The Ja Twelve is criticized for its value and price, and the Downshifter 14 is praised for its performance and innovation.

takeaways.text: Design and Materials: Continue to focus on innovative and high-quality materials, as reviewers have praised the design and materials of the Alphafly 4 and other Nike products.
Performance and Innovation: Emphasize the performance and innovation of Nike products, as reviewers have praised the Alphafly 4 and other Nike products for their performance and innovative features.
